title: Left inverse for the punctured matching chart restriction
statement: In the notation of the punctured matching chart, the section map induced by the punctured comparison admits a ring-homomorphic left inverse on the image of the matching-ring restriction.

source.place: Tags 0BLH and 05ER, localized affine chart comparison.

proof.text: Apply the ring-equivalence comparison theorem for the localized formal-gluing chart and take its underlying ring homomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem puncturedMatching_chart_restriction_leftInverse
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A) (hf :
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) ≤ U) :
    let W := (D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
    let ρ := ((ΓSpecIso D.matchingRing).inv ≫
      (W.ι ≫ (D.modelMap ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).appTop).hom
    let ψ := (D.puncturedMap ∣_ W).appTop.hom
    ∃ g : Γ((D.puncturedMap ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme, ⊤) →+* Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤),
      ∀ b : D.matchingRing, g (ψ (ρ b)) = ρ b
